{"acceptable":false, "problems":[
"The pose appears to be standing, but the pelvis is too high relative to the root, suggesting a seated posture. The chest is also too high. The arm positions are symmetrical and lack dynamism. The leg positions are also symmetrical and lack dynamism. The chair placement is unclear and doesn't integrate with the figure's pose.",
"The arm_lower_l and hand_l are at the same y coordinate, which is unrealistic. The arm_lower_r and hand_r are also at the same y coordinate.",
"The leg_foot_l and leg_foot_r are at the same y coordinate, which is unrealistic."
], "corrections":[
"Move pelvis y coordinate from 0.550000011920929 to 0.65. This will lower the pelvis and suggest a seated position.",
"Move chest y coordinate from 0.44999998807907104 to 0.55. This will lower the chest and align it with the new pelvis position.",
"Move arm_lower_l y coordinate from 0.4000000059604645 to 0.35. This will create a more natural arm bend.",
"Move hand_l y coordinate from 0.4000000059604645 to 0.30. This will separate the hand from the forearm.",
"Move arm_lower_r y coordinate from 0.4000000059604645 to 0.35. This will create a more natural arm bend.",
"Move hand_r y coordinate from 0.4000000059604645 to 0.30. This will separate the hand from the forearm.",
"Move leg_foot_l y coordinate from 0.75 to 0.65. This will create a more natural leg bend.",
"Move leg_foot_r y coordinate from 0.75 to 0.65. This will create a more natural leg bend."
]}
